title: Independent reproduction of Li2S decomposition barriers on Fe3Se4 and Fe2NiSe4
difficulty_reasons: The Agent must construct and validate surface terminations, adsorbate endpoints and minimum-energy paths that are not supplied as public geometries.
Two chemically distinct hosts require comparable candidate coverage and convergence evidence before a kinetic comparison is defensible.

paper.title: Fe–Se–Ni Synergistic Nanoreactors in Hierarchical Porous Fe2NiSe4@rGO Hosts for High-Rate Lithium–Sulfur Batteries

data.description: Stable ICSD host records and explicit neutral Li2S endpoint/barrier definitions.

required_deliverables.description: Validated host-specific barrier results, process evidence, comparison and limitations.
